scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Source method and prior results are attributed; analytic proof and standalone finite diagnostics are provided; no independent audit or global publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proved: For any unequal strictly positive initial pair and each fixed finite number of sweeps, the one-step mass diverges as the normalized stiffness grows, with proved parity and iterated-exponential log-ratio asymptotics; equal starts are fixed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact-arithmetic two-node Gauss-Lobatto exponential predictor and a fixed finite number of explicit correction sweeps on symmetric positive two-compartment exchange.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.unproved: Nothing about arbitrary generators, other quadrature nodes, fully implicit collocation, limits involving an increasing sweep count, or finite-precision robustness.

title: All-sweep exponential mass blow-up on a conservative exchange flow
